Pole Mallakhamb.rule: All parts of the Pole should be properly utilized.
One Acrobatic element of 'B' part should be executed from both sides.
Continuous 3 Acrobatic elements of which at least one should be 'B' part
At least one Vertical Hold part.
At least one Horizontal Hold part.
One Hold part demonstrating flexibility of back bone.
At least two transitions from one hold position to another Hold position.

Hanging Mallakhamb.rule: All parts of the Hanging Mallakhamb should be properly utilized.
Acrobatic element of 'A' part from both sides.
Continuous 3 Acrobatic elements of which at least 1 should be 'B' part
At least one Vertical Hold part.
At least one Horizontal Hold part.
At least one transitions from one hold position to another Hold position.

Rope Mallakhamb.rule: At Least once the rope should be held in legs at 4 meter height
At least 2 hold parts showing forward & backward flexibility (Both elements should be performed)
At least one Vertical and one Horizontal Hold part.
